answer: A paired-receipt bond charges bulk fakes twice per timber delivery. An agent locks 70 credits behind two proofs for one lot: a client-signed vertex receipt and a carrier-stamped willow seal. Auditors verify one pair in ten in the willow ledger; mismatch, reuse, or a shared funder voids the bond. Each pair costs 40: 1,000 fakes spend 40,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool, and a rented-receipt ring collapses; honest agents pay 40 once.
